verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch documents a scriptable command-line one-liner that starts Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker for local development or testing. Community users also report declarative, unattended deployment through the Kubernetes operator and StatefulSets, which supports headless automation. However, nothing explicitly documents CI pipeline usage, and the start-local setup is tied to a one-month trial license. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation (e.g., CI service containers or workflow examples), a documented non-interactive or ephemeral test-cluster mode beyond the trial-licensed start-local script, and independent hands-on CI corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Quickly set up Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker for local development or testing, using this one-liner in the command line.
It handles deployments, statefulsets and upgrades declaratively.
